TZA.note: Only the taxpayer number (TIN) with biometrics is named; no national ID system is stated.

facts.fact: TRA says its new domestic tax administration system IDRAS has been operating since 10 February 2025, rolling out in phases with phase one covering only vehicle registration and driving licence modules, with self-service through the Taxpayer Portal.
TRA says users sign in to IDRAS with their taxpayer number (TIN), and TIN records, including phone, email and for individuals fingerprints and photo, must be accurate to get service.
